rationale: The agent verified the user by full name and zip via tool lookup before accessing account data. It enumerated the user’s orders, retrieved each order’s details, and correctly identified the one shipped to Texas. It provided the correct tracking number from the tool. Before making changes, it clearly stated the intended return (Electric Kettle and Mechanical Keyboard, excluding the Pet Bed) and requested explicit confirmation. After receiving confirmation, it used the proper tool to initiate the return for the correct item IDs and refund method (PayPal), and then confirmed the initiation. No unsupported claims or actions on the wrong account were made, and all information aligns with tool outputs. The process followed policy requirements for authentication, confirmation prior to writes, and accurate final information.
